Market today: Strong GDP and surging inflation suggest the Fed might stay hawkish, which is tough for growth stocks. Plus, big tech like Google and Microsoft are slowing AI spending, a direct hit to your chip/tech heavy book.

Your holdings: You've got several leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) and SMCI in "SELL" status, all down significantly (-18% to -52%). Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH and QQQI are also flagged for "TRIM."

Watch: Keep a close eye on inflation data and any Fed comments. Also, watch for further news on tech capital expenditure trends.

Bottom line: Your portfolio is highly exposed to tech headwinds and rising rate concerns; risk management is paramount.
plays: Review stops on leveraged "SELL" positions like SOXL (-52.24%) and SPAL (-39.48%); their current stops (200, 21.38) are far from market price (107.35, 15.22) and need immediate adjustment.
Consider trimming SMH (-10.8%) and QQQI (-3.48%) as per scanner status to reduce overall tech exposure given the inflation and AI capex news.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market signals are too mixed for new tech entries, and scanner setups lack a strong external catalyst.
